sources.name: OpenJLPT
sources.attribution: Contains data from OpenJLPT (CC BY-SA 4.0), which uses JMdict and KANJIDIC2 (EDRDG), Jonathan Waller's JLPT lists, and Tatoeba.
sources.usedFor: N5 vocabulary, kanji and English glosses (source of the Polish glosses).
sources.usedForPl: Słówka i kanji N5 oraz angielskie znaczenia, z których powstały polskie.

sources.name: JMdict / KANJIDIC2 (EDRDG)
sources.attribution: JMdict and KANJIDIC2 are the property of the Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group, used in conformance with the Group's licence (via OpenJLPT).
sources.usedFor: Readings, meanings and kanji data, through OpenJLPT.
sources.usedForPl: Czytania, znaczenia i dane o kanji (przez OpenJLPT).

sources.name: Jonathan Waller's JLPT Resources
sources.attribution: JLPT level assignments by Jonathan Waller (tanos.co.uk), via OpenJLPT.
sources.usedFor: Unofficial N5 level lists, through OpenJLPT.

sources.name: Tatoeba
sources.attribution: Example sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), each linked by its sentence id to its contributors at https://tatoeba.org/sentences/show/<id>.
sources.usedFor: Example sentences (Japanese and English). No Tatoeba audio is used.
sources.usedForPl: Zdania przykładowe. Nie używamy nagrań z Tatoeby.

sources.name: KanjiVG
sources.attribution: Stroke order data from KanjiVG by Ulrich Apel and contributors (CC BY-SA 3.0).
sources.usedFor: Stroke order animations for kana and N5 kanji.
sources.usedForPl: Animacje kolejności kresek dla kany i kanji N5.

sources.name: Tae Kim's Guide to Learning Japanese
sources.attribution: Grammar topic order cross-checked against Tae Kim's Guide. No text was copied.
sources.usedFor: Topic order reference only. All grammar notes are original.
sources.usedForPl: Tylko kolejność tematów. Notki gramatyczne są napisane od zera.

sources.name: Aka Nihongo (this app)
sources.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (Polish glosses); original notes and mnemonics by the project
sources.attribution: Polish glosses are a translation of OpenJLPT's English glosses and are shared under CC BY-SA 4.0.
sources.usedFor: Polish glosses, grammar notes, kana mnemonics, mascot.
sources.usedForPl: Polskie znaczenia, notki gramatyczne, skojarzenia do kany i maskotka.
